findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: Inspectors observed a gap between the mop sink and the wall. PIC was informed. Ensure to seal mop sink to the wall.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed 4 areas in need of general cleaning:

-The first area is the top of the dish machine. There is a build-up of food debris on the top of the machine from regular use.
-The second area is the racks in the proofing unit. The racks were observed to contain a build-up of food debris. 
-The third area is the racks in the walk-in cooler. The racks were observed to contain a build-up of food debris. Repeat.
-The fourth area is the dish drying and storage racks. The dish drying and storage racks have accumulated dust and debris over time. Repeat.

Discussed all areas with PIC. PIC stated the racks are in the process of being cleaned. See that they are all cleaned by 2026. See that the top of the dish machine is cleaned by 2026 as well.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
3-305.11: There was a box of single service articles in the back and a few boxes of food in the walk-in freezer observed to be stored on the floor in the facility. Ensure that all food is stored at least six inches off of the ground to protect them from contamination. 

 (A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-602.13: The following nonfood contact surfaces are observed to be in need of a cleaning: 

1. The dish shelves. 
2. The floor behind the fryer and wing station. 
3. The floor under the dish area. 
4. The walk-in shelves. 

Ensure that all nonfood contact surfaces are cleaned and maintained cleaned to avoid accumulation of soil residues. 

 NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Areas in need of sealing or caulking:
-along the top of the 3 part sink
-multiple holes in the stainless steel above the 3 part sink
Discussed with PIC.  Ensure these areas are caulked to prevent mold growth and pest entry/harborage.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Paper towel dispensers were empty during inspection, although there were paper towels available next to sink by pizza prep area.  PIC corrected on site.  Ensure hand washing sinks are properly stocked at all times. 

6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
Pizza prep coolers did not have thermometers present inside, although they do have an outside temperature display showing the inside temperature reading.  Coolers require a thermometer located inside the cooler for an accurate reading.  Ensure all coolers have thermometers placed inside.

4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. (B) EQUIPMENT holding TCS FOOD shall have TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE affixed to device. (C) Does not apply to EQUIPMENT without practical means of measuring ambient air surroundings. (D) TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be designed to be easily readable. C (E) FOOD and water TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall have numerical scale, printed record, or digital readout in increments no greater than 1C or 2F in the intended range of use. Pf

findings.title: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage and display
findings.comment:
Containers holding frosting and dressing were observed to be stored uncovered and underneath a shelf holding pizza boxes.  The shelving was observed to be dirty, allowing for possible contamination.  Ensure shelves are clean and frosting and dressing containers are covered.

3-305.11: (A) FOOD shall be protected from contamination: In clean dry location, not exposed to any form of contamination, at least 6 inches above floor. (B) FOOD in working containers and packages may be stored less than 6 inches on case lot handling EQUIPMENT. (C) Pressurized BEVERAGE containers, cased FOOD in waterproof containers, and milk containers in plastic crates may be stored on floor.

findings.title: In-use utensils: properly stored
findings.comment:
Whisks used for food preparation were stored hanging on an unclean hook by the whisk.  PIC was notified and the whisks were washed and will be stored in a container for future use.  Ensure utensils are not in contact with unclean storage areas. 

3-304.12: FOOD preparation and dispensing UTENSILS shall be stored: (A) in FOOD with their handles above top of FOOD and container (B) In non-TCS FOOD (C) On clean portion of FOOD preparation table or cooking EQUIPMENT as long as UTENSIL cleaned with proper frequency (Time/Temp Control Form). (D) In running water with sufficient velocity (E) In clean, protected location if UTENSILS are used only for FOOD not TCS (F) In container of water at least 135F and container is properly cleaned.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
Dishwasher was tested after running and showed a chlorine concentration of 10 ppm.  Dishwasher was run two more times, showing the same result.  The inspectors offered to use the facility test strips, and found they were unusable as they had gotten wet.  Sanitizer bucket did have some liquid present, but was replaced and the dishwasher was ran again.  Same results were obtained.  Inspector asked PIC to prime the sanitizer line and run the dishwasher again after priming.  After the line was primed, a reading of 50 ppm was observed.  Ensure usable test strips are present and kept in a safe, dry area.  Ensure dishwasher is tested periodically.


4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
The floor and a portion of the wall in the back dry storage area had mold growth.  Ensure spills are cleaned properly to avoid mold growth.

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Tiles were observed to be missing behind the fryer.  PIC stated DM was notified and the DM stated she would call someone to have them come and replace the tiles.  Ensure tiles are replaced by next inspection.

6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-103.11: (O) FOOD EMPLOYEES are informed in verifiable manner of their responsibility to report accordance with LAW, to PIC, information about their health related to disease transmissible through FOOD.  

Facility does not have a verifiable system to demonstrate employees are properly educated on foodborne illness reporting responsibility. Pizza Hut's online system tracks employee food safety course scores but unable to demonstrate curricula associated with that score to verify employee health is part of it. Provided SCDPH employee health information. Ensure employees have signed reporting agreements on file (facility has a binder full of employee information, this would be a good place to maintain these records).

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use.

Hand sink next to 3-compartment sink and dish machine is blocked by two pizza racks. Ensure racks and other equipment are stored elsewhere so as to not block handwashing facilities. PIC removed racks from this area.

findings.title: Food separated and protected
findings.comment:
3-302.11: (A) (1)-(2) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination during storage, preparation, holding, and display (P). (3) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by cleaning visibly soiled containers, removing damaged containers, separating washed and unwashed produce (C).  

Facility currently does not have a dumpster and is storing refuse in the back corner of kitchen, adjacent to dry storage and hot holding cabinet. This creates the potential for contamination to occur whether from leaking garbage, rodent harborage etc. Garbage must not be allowed to accumulate near food prep or storage facilities. Contact landlord/owner/utility provider to get dumpster service reinstated at facility. Will follow up.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). 

Chlorine sanitizing dish machine showing a concentration of 0ppm. After troubleshooting with PIC Kara (changing out sanitizer bucket, snipping cinched end of tube, re-priming) the machine still showing a concentration of 0 ppm. PIC contacted service technician and left a voicemail. PIC advised to utilize the 3-compartment sink in the meantime to complete the wash, rinse, sanitize process. Will follow up.

findings.title: Garbage & refuse properly disposed; facilities maintained
findings.comment:
5-501.12: If used, an outdoor enclosure for REFUSE, recyclables, and returnables shall be constructed of durable and cleanable materials. 

Dumpster currently not available at facility. See violation #15. Contact landlord/owner/utility provider to get dumpster service reinstated at facility.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
6-403.11: (A) Areas designated for EMPLOYEES to eat, drink, and use tobacco shall be located so that FOOD, EQUIPMENT, LINENS, and SINGLESERVICE and SINGLE-USE ARTICLES are protected from contamination. 

Upon entry, a soda can was observed on top of pizza prep cooler. Discussed contamination risk with PIC Kara. Employee discarded their drink.
